# anthropic_telemetry_destination (Resource)

Beta. Manages an OpenTelemetry (OTLP/HTTP) telemetry destination for the organization (`/v1/organizations/telemetry_destinations`). Use `anthropic_telemetry_destination_workspace` to manage the workspace list when `workspace_scope` is `include` or `exclude`. Changing `workspace_scope` empties the workspace list. Apply again to re-attach those resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "otel_collector_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Send spans from selected workspaces to an OTLP/HTTP collector
resource "anthropic_telemetry_destination" "collector" {
  display_name    = "Example collector"
  endpoint_url    = "https://collector.example.com/otlp"
  workspace_scope = "include"

  headers = {
    authorization = "Bearer ${var.otel_collector_token}"
  }

  traces_content_mode = "metadata_only"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint_url` (String) Base HTTPS URL of the collector's OTLP/HTTP endpoint, without `/v1/traces`. The API appends it.
- `workspace_scope` (String) Which workspaces the destination covers: `all`, `include` (only listed workspaces) or `exclude` (all but listed workspaces). Changing it empties the destination's workspace list.

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name, 1 to 255 characters.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the destination receives deliveries. The API can disable a destination on its own, for example after sustained delivery failures. The next apply re-enables it.
- `headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Request headers sent with every delivery, typically the collector's authentication header. Values are write-only. The API never returns them, so a value changed outside Terraform is not detected. They are not populated on import.
- `traces_content_mode` (String) What exported spans contain: `metadata_only` or `content` (prompts, responses, and tool inputs and outputs).
- `traces_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the destination receives traces.
- `traces_endpoint_url` (String) Full traces URL for a collector that doesn't take traces on `/v1/traces`. Must have the same scheme, host and port as `endpoint_url`.
- `traces_max_content_bytes` (Number) Most bytes of content one exported span can contain. Unset means only the API's maximum applies.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the destination was created.
- `disabled_reason` (String) Why the destination is disabled (`caller`, `sustained_failure`, `invalid_address`, `redirect`), or `null` when enabled.
- `header_names` (List of String) Names of the registered request headers, as returned by the API.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the destination (`tdst_...`).
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the last configuration or state change.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Header values are write-only and are not imported. Set them in configuration.
terraform import anthropic_telemetry_destination.collector tdst_01ABCDEF
```
